hypothesis: Prior premium momentum normalized by its own daily range and stricter prior liquidity may improve next-opening event precision over raw close/open momentum. This is a testable hypothesis, not an assumed improvement.
instrument: Exact NSE F&O option symbol, expiry, strike and CE/PE side
horizon: Previous session close to verified immediately following session opening reference

feature.name: intraday_premium_momentum_per_range
feature.source: Previous dated official NSE UDiFF F&O raw snapshot
feature.missingness: Exclude and report any missing/nonfinite/invalid field; no outcome-derived imputation
feature.validity: positive open and close; high > low >= 0; open and close inside observed range; expiry >= next-session date

selection.ranking: Descending feature, then lexicographic exact identity
selection.rounding: floor; zero eligible selections remain zero

data_plan.known_inspected_dates_excluded_from_unto: All July and September 2026 diagnostics and September 2024/2025 annual endpoints
data_plan.missing_session_or_unknown_availability: NOT_PROVEN; do not join across gaps

comparators: Existing raw close/open momentum top100 diagnostic
Top-decile raw close/open momentum on the SAME prior-qualified universe

evaluation.multiple_distribution: Full, uncapped, all matched prior-qualified contracts
evaluation.actual_cost_proof: Requires dated exchange/tax/broker schedules, contract lot size, bid/ask and slippage before any net performance claim
evaluation.catalyst_version: No-catalyst baseline; any catalyst addition must be separately registered and ablated
evaluation.multiple_testing: Record all prior tried variants; do not promote on one nominal p-value or an in-sample score
